summary: Six-operator FM synth in the DX7 style: 32 algorithms, DX7 ranges and envelopes, loads DX7 SysEx banks. Use it for electric pianos, bells, FM basses, brass and metallic tones.
use_for: Bells, electric pianos, FM basses and metallic percussion from six operators and many algorithms.

parameters.name: Algorithm
parameters.description: Which operators modulate which (the 32 DX7 algorithms)
parameters.how: Chooses which of the 32 wiring layouts decides how the six operators modulate each other and which reach the output.
parameters.sound: Different algorithms give different families of sounds, from stacked bell and organ layers to deep modulation chains for brass and basses.

parameters.name: Feedback
parameters.description: Self-modulation of the feedback operator (7: near saw)
parameters.how: Sets how strongly the feedback operator modulates itself, from 0 to 7.
parameters.sound: Low values add a little brightness and edge, and high values turn the tone towards a buzzy saw and then noise.

parameters.name: Osc key sync
parameters.description: Operators restart their phase with each note
parameters.how: Makes the operators restart their phase with each new note.
parameters.sound: On gives the same attack every time, and off lets the phase float for a looser, more varied start.

parameters.name: Transpose
parameters.how: Transposes the whole voice by up to 24 semitones either way.
parameters.sound: Use it to move a patch to the register where it sounds best.

parameters.name: PEG rate 1
parameters.how: Sets how fast the pitch envelope moves through stage 1, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: Fast rates make the pitch change instantly and slow rates make it glide.

parameters.name: PEG rate 2
parameters.how: Sets how fast the pitch envelope moves through stage 2, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: Fast rates make the pitch change instantly and slow rates make it glide.

parameters.name: PEG rate 3
parameters.how: Sets how fast the pitch envelope moves through stage 3, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: Fast rates make the pitch change instantly and slow rates make it glide.

parameters.name: PEG rate 4
parameters.how: Sets how fast the pitch envelope moves through stage 4, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: Fast rates make the pitch change instantly and slow rates make it glide.

parameters.name: PEG level 1
parameters.description: Pitch envelope level 1 (50: no shift; 0/99: about −4/+4 octaves)
parameters.how: Sets the pitch the envelope reaches at stage 1, where 50 is no shift and the ends are about four octaves down or up.
parameters.sound: Moving the levels away from 50 adds pitch swoops, such as a short rise at the start of a note.

parameters.name: PEG level 2
parameters.description: Pitch envelope level 2 (50: no shift; 0/99: about −4/+4 octaves)
parameters.how: Sets the pitch the envelope reaches at stage 2, where 50 is no shift and the ends are about four octaves down or up.
parameters.sound: Moving the levels away from 50 adds pitch swoops, such as a short rise at the start of a note.

parameters.name: PEG level 3
parameters.description: Pitch envelope level 3 (50: no shift; 0/99: about −4/+4 octaves)
parameters.how: Sets the pitch the envelope reaches at stage 3, where 50 is no shift and the ends are about four octaves down or up.
parameters.sound: Moving the levels away from 50 adds pitch swoops, such as a short rise at the start of a note.

parameters.name: PEG level 4
parameters.description: Pitch envelope level 4 (50: no shift; 0/99: about −4/+4 octaves)
parameters.how: Sets the pitch the envelope reaches at stage 4, where 50 is no shift and the ends are about four octaves down or up.
parameters.sound: Moving the levels away from 50 adds pitch swoops, such as a short rise at the start of a note.

parameters.name: LFO wave
parameters.how: Chooses the LFO waveform: triangle, falling or rising saw, square, sine or random steps.
parameters.sound: Smooth shapes make vibrato, square makes trills, and random steps make stepped, unpredictable movement.

parameters.name: LFO speed
parameters.description: LFO rate (0: 0.06 Hz, 35: about 6 Hz, 99: about 24 Hz)
parameters.how: Sets the LFO speed from 0 to 99, about 0.06 Hz to 24 Hz.
parameters.sound: Low values are slow drifts and high values a fast flutter.

parameters.name: LFO delay
parameters.description: Time before the LFO fades in after a note
parameters.how: Sets how long after a note the LFO takes to fade in, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: A delay lets the note start steady and add vibrato later, as a singer would.

parameters.name: LFO pitch
parameters.description: Pitch modulation depth (scaled by Pitch sens)
parameters.how: Sets how deeply the LFO modulates pitch, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: More depth gives a stronger vibrato.

parameters.name: LFO amp
parameters.description: Amplitude modulation depth (scaled by each operator's Amp sens)
parameters.how: Sets how deeply the LFO modulates amplitude, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: More depth gives a stronger tremolo on the operators that respond to it.

parameters.name: LFO key sync
parameters.description: The LFO restarts with each note
parameters.how: Makes the LFO restart with each note.
parameters.sound: On gives every note the same vibrato start, and off lets the LFO run freely.

parameters.name: Pitch sens
parameters.description: How far LFO, mod wheel and aftertouch move the pitch
parameters.how: Sets how far the LFO, mod wheel and aftertouch can move the pitch, from 0 to 7.
parameters.sound: Low values keep vibrato subtle and high values make it wide.

parameters.name: Voice mode
parameters.description: Poly; Mono retriggers; Legato glides without retriggering
parameters.how: Chooses how notes share voices: Poly plays chords, Mono retriggers on each note, Legato glides between overlapping notes.
parameters.sound: Poly suits keys and pads, Mono gives a punchy lead or bass, and Legato gives smooth, connected lines.

parameters.name: Polyphony
parameters.how: Sets how many notes can sound at once, from 1 to 16.
parameters.sound: More voices let chords and long releases overlap, and fewer save processing power.

parameters.name: Unison
parameters.how: Sets the number of stacked voices per note, from 1 to 4.
parameters.sound: More voices make the note thicker and wider, and one voice is a single clean tone.

parameters.name: Uni detune
parameters.description: Detune between unison voices (up to ±25 cents)
parameters.how: Sets how far apart the unison voices are tuned, up to 25 cents.
parameters.sound: Small amounts give a warm thickness and large ones a wide chorus-like swarm.

parameters.name: Uni spread
parameters.how: Sets how widely the unison voices are spread across the stereo field, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: More spread makes the note wider, and zero keeps it centred.

parameters.name: Glide mode
parameters.how: Chooses when notes slide into each other: never, always, or only on overlapping notes.
parameters.sound: Gliding adds a singing slur between notes.

parameters.name: Glide
parameters.how: Sets how long the slide takes, up to 2 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short glides are subtle and long ones sweep slowly between pitches.

parameters.name: Bend range
parameters.how: Sets how far the pitch bend wheel moves the pitch, from 0 to 12 semitones.
parameters.sound: A small range gives expressive nudges and a large one gives big sweeps.

parameters.name: Wheel pitch
parameters.description: Mod wheel → pitch modulation (vibrato from the LFO)
parameters.how: Sets how much the mod wheel adds LFO vibrato, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: Pushing the wheel up brings in vibrato, which makes held notes feel more expressive.

parameters.name: Wheel amp
parameters.how: Sets how much the mod wheel adds LFO tremolo, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: Pushing the wheel up brings in a pulsing volume change.

parameters.name: AT pitch
parameters.how: Sets how much key pressure after the note starts adds LFO vibrato, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: Pressing harder on a held key adds vibrato.

parameters.name: AT amp
parameters.how: Sets how much key pressure after the note starts adds LFO tremolo, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: Pressing harder on a held key adds a pulsing volume change.

parameters.name: Tone
parameters.description: Gentle low-pass on the output (20 kHz: open)
parameters.how: Applies a gentle low-pass filter to the output, from 1 to 20 kHz.
parameters.sound: Lowering it takes the edge off the top, and fully open it leaves the sound unfiltered.

parameters.name: Engine
parameters.description: Clean: 2× oversampled; Raw: the original's aliasing grit
parameters.how: Chooses Clean (oversampled twice) or Raw (no oversampling).
parameters.sound: Clean is smooth and quiet at the top, and Raw keeps the gritty aliasing of the classic hardware sound.

parameters.name: Volume
parameters.how: Sets the output level of the synth, from -40 to +6 dB, or off.
parameters.sound: Use it to place the instrument in the mix without changing its tone.

parameters.name: Op1 on
parameters.description: Operator 1 sounds (off: silent, as on the DX7)
parameters.how: Turns operator 1 on or off.
parameters.sound: Muting one operator shows what it adds to the sound.

parameters.name: Op1 level
parameters.how: Sets the output level of operator 1, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: For a carrier this is loudness, and for a modulator it is brightness: more level makes a harsher, richer tone.

parameters.name: Op1 mode
parameters.description: Ratio: follows the note; Fixed: a fixed frequency
parameters.how: Chooses whether operator 1 follows the note pitch or runs at a fixed frequency.
parameters.sound: Ratio mode plays in tune across the keyboard, and Fixed mode gives a constant tone for noise-like or percussive effects.

parameters.name: Op1 coarse
parameters.how: Sets the frequency ratio of operator 1 in whole steps, from 0.5 to 31.
parameters.sound: Whole-number ratios give harmonic tones and others give bells and metallic sounds.

parameters.name: Op1 fine
parameters.how: Adds a fine amount to the frequency ratio of operator 1, from 0 to 99 %.
parameters.sound: Small offsets detune the operator for a slow beating, and larger ones give inharmonic colour.

parameters.name: Op1 detune
parameters.description: Detune, −7 … +7 (about 1 cent a step at A4)
parameters.how: Detunes operator 1 by about 7 cents either way.
parameters.sound: A little detune adds a gentle movement against the other operators.

parameters.name: Op1 wave
parameters.how: Chooses the waveform of operator 1: sine, half sine, absolute sine or pulse sine.
parameters.sound: Sine is the classic tone, and the other shapes add more harmonics and a harsher edge.

parameters.name: Op1 rate 1
parameters.how: Sets how fast the envelope of operator 1 moves through stage 1, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: Fast rates make instant changes, and slow rates make the level glide over time.

parameters.name: Op1 rate 2
parameters.how: Sets how fast the envelope of operator 1 moves through stage 2, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: Fast rates make instant changes, and slow rates make the level glide over time.

parameters.name: Op1 rate 3
parameters.how: Sets how fast the envelope of operator 1 moves through stage 3, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: Fast rates make instant changes, and slow rates make the level glide over time.

parameters.name: Op1 rate 4
parameters.how: Sets how fast the envelope of operator 1 moves through stage 4, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: Fast rates make instant changes, and slow rates make the level glide over time.

parameters.name: Op1 level 1
parameters.how: Sets the level of the envelope of operator 1 at stage 1, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: Together the four levels shape how the operator swells, decays and fades away.

parameters.name: Op1 level 2
parameters.how: Sets the level of the envelope of operator 1 at stage 2, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: Together the four levels shape how the operator swells, decays and fades away.

parameters.name: Op1 level 3
parameters.how: Sets the level of the envelope of operator 1 at stage 3, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: Together the four levels shape how the operator swells, decays and fades away.

parameters.name: Op1 level 4
parameters.how: Sets the level of the envelope of operator 1 at stage 4, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: Together the four levels shape how the operator swells, decays and fades away.

parameters.name: Op1 break
parameters.how: Sets the key at which level scaling for operator 1 changes sides, from 0 to 99, where 39 is middle C.
parameters.sound: Notes either side of the break point are scaled by the depth settings.

parameters.name: Op1 L depth
parameters.description: Level scaling below the break point
parameters.how: Sets how much the level of operator 1 changes for keys below the break point, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: It lets low notes sound brighter or softer than the middle of the keyboard.

parameters.name: Op1 R depth
parameters.description: Level scaling above the break point
parameters.how: Sets how much the level of operator 1 changes for keys above the break point, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: It lets high notes sound brighter or softer than the middle of the keyboard.

parameters.name: Op1 L curve
parameters.description: Scaling curve below the break point
parameters.how: Chooses the shape of the level scaling below the break point: linear or exponential, falling or rising.
parameters.sound: Exponential curves change faster near the extremes, linear curves change evenly.

parameters.name: Op1 R curve
parameters.description: Scaling curve above the break point
parameters.how: Chooses the shape of the level scaling above the break point: linear or exponential, falling or rising.
parameters.sound: Exponential curves change faster near the extremes, linear curves change evenly.

parameters.name: Op1 rate sc
parameters.description: Envelopes run faster for higher notes
parameters.how: Makes the envelope of operator 1 run faster for higher notes, from 0 to 7.
parameters.sound: Higher notes decay sooner, as they do on a plucked or struck instrument.

parameters.name: Op1 amp sens
parameters.description: How much LFO / wheel / aftertouch amplitude modulation applies
parameters.how: Sets how much LFO, wheel and aftertouch amplitude modulation reaches operator 1, from 0 to 3.
parameters.sound: Higher values let tremolo shape this operator, and zero leaves it steady.

parameters.name: Op1 vel sens
parameters.description: How much velocity changes the level
parameters.how: Sets how much note velocity changes the level of operator 1, from 0 to 7.
parameters.sound: Higher values make hard playing brighter or louder, depending on whether it is a modulator or a carrier.

parameters.sound: Higher values make hard playing brighter or louder, depending on whether it is a modulator or a carrier.

parameters.name: Op5 on
parameters.description: Operator 5 sounds (off: silent, as on the DX7)
parameters.how: Turns operator 5 on or off.
parameters.sound: Muting one operator shows what it adds to the sound.

parameters.name: Op5 level
parameters.how: Sets the output level of operator 5, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: For a carrier this is loudness, and for a modulator it is brightness: more level makes a harsher, richer tone.

parameters.name: Op5 mode
parameters.description: Ratio: follows the note; Fixed: a fixed frequency
parameters.how: Chooses whether operator 5 follows the note pitch or runs at a fixed frequency.
parameters.sound: Ratio mode plays in tune across the keyboard, and Fixed mode gives a constant tone for noise-like or percussive effects.

parameters.name: Op5 coarse
parameters.how: Sets the frequency ratio of operator 5 in whole steps, from 0.5 to 31.
parameters.sound: Whole-number ratios give harmonic tones and others give bells and metallic sounds.

parameters.name: Op5 fine
parameters.how: Adds a fine amount to the frequency ratio of operator 5, from 0 to 99 %.
parameters.sound: Small offsets detune the operator for a slow beating, and larger ones give inharmonic colour.

parameters.name: Op5 detune
parameters.description: Detune, −7 … +7 (about 1 cent a step at A4)
parameters.how: Detunes operator 5 by about 7 cents either way.
parameters.sound: A little detune adds a gentle movement against the other operators.

parameters.name: Op5 wave
parameters.how: Chooses the waveform of operator 5: sine, half sine, absolute sine or pulse sine.
parameters.sound: Sine is the classic tone, and the other shapes add more harmonics and a harsher edge.

parameters.name: Op5 rate 1
parameters.how: Sets how fast the envelope of operator 5 moves through stage 1, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: Fast rates make instant changes, and slow rates make the level glide over time.

parameters.name: Op5 rate 2
parameters.how: Sets how fast the envelope of operator 5 moves through stage 2, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: Fast rates make instant changes, and slow rates make the level glide over time.

parameters.name: Op5 rate 3
parameters.how: Sets how fast the envelope of operator 5 moves through stage 3, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: Fast rates make instant changes, and slow rates make the level glide over time.

parameters.name: Op5 rate 4
parameters.how: Sets how fast the envelope of operator 5 moves through stage 4, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: Fast rates make instant changes, and slow rates make the level glide over time.

parameters.name: Op5 level 1
parameters.how: Sets the level of the envelope of operator 5 at stage 1, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: Together the four levels shape how the operator swells, decays and fades away.

parameters.name: Op5 level 2
parameters.how: Sets the level of the envelope of operator 5 at stage 2, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: Together the four levels shape how the operator swells, decays and fades away.

parameters.name: Op5 level 3
parameters.how: Sets the level of the envelope of operator 5 at stage 3, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: Together the four levels shape how the operator swells, decays and fades away.

parameters.name: Op5 level 4
parameters.how: Sets the level of the envelope of operator 5 at stage 4, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: Together the four levels shape how the operator swells, decays and fades away.

parameters.name: Op5 break
parameters.how: Sets the key at which level scaling for operator 5 changes sides, from 0 to 99, where 39 is middle C.
parameters.sound: Notes either side of the break point are scaled by the depth settings.

parameters.name: Op5 L depth
parameters.description: Level scaling below the break point
parameters.how: Sets how much the level of operator 5 changes for keys below the break point, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: It lets low notes sound brighter or softer than the middle of the keyboard.

parameters.name: Op5 R depth
parameters.description: Level scaling above the break point
parameters.how: Sets how much the level of operator 5 changes for keys above the break point, from 0 to 99.
parameters.sound: It lets high notes sound brighter or softer than the middle of the keyboard.

parameters.name: Op5 L curve
parameters.description: Scaling curve below the break point
parameters.how: Chooses the shape of the level scaling below the break point: linear or exponential, falling or rising.
parameters.sound: Exponential curves change faster near the extremes, linear curves change evenly.

parameters.name: Op5 R curve
parameters.description: Scaling curve above the break point
parameters.how: Chooses the shape of the level scaling above the break point: linear or exponential, falling or rising.
parameters.sound: Exponential curves change faster near the extremes, linear curves change evenly.

parameters.name: Op5 rate sc
parameters.description: Envelopes run faster for higher notes
parameters.how: Makes the envelope of operator 5 run faster for higher notes, from 0 to 7.
parameters.sound: Higher notes decay sooner, as they do on a plucked or struck instrument.

parameters.name: Op5 amp sens
parameters.description: How much LFO / wheel / aftertouch amplitude modulation applies
parameters.how: Sets how much LFO, wheel and aftertouch amplitude modulation reaches operator 5, from 0 to 3.
parameters.sound: Higher values let tremolo shape this operator, and zero leaves it steady.

parameters.name: Op5 vel sens
parameters.description: How much velocity changes the level
parameters.how: Sets how much note velocity changes the level of operator 5, from 0 to 7.
parameters.sound: Higher values make hard playing brighter or louder, depending on whether it is a modulator or a carrier.
